note: Post-request sleep for the WFM scrape, ~3 req/s. Shared by wfm_demand.py (REQUEST_DELAY, seconds) and companion/wfm-scrape/src/http.rs (REQUEST_DELAY, a Duration). This is the one shared constant NEITHER parity gate can see: both stub the sleeper — Python patches time.sleep, Rust injects NoopSleeper — so a bump on one side alone changes production scrape pacing with every existing test still green. Raising it slows a ~45-minute full scrape; lowering it risks WFM rate-limiting the box.
